shots.intent: 首屏一眼传达3D立体白色口罩＋盒装的干净卫生感，赢得搜索与详情页点击。
shots.textZone: upper clean blue band for headline plus sub-line; chip row beneath

shots.intent: 放大普通平面口罩塌陷贴嘴、勒耳、闷呼起雾的日常佩戴困扰，制造替换动机。
shots.textZone: one headline at the top; no other copy

shots.intent: 左右同框对照贴合、空间与亲肤三点差异，把立体裁剪讲成可买的核心利益。
shots.textZone: column headers plus three pill labels per column

shots.intent: 用逐层分离的材质剖面讲清四层用料结构，让买家看懂成本花在哪里。
shots.textZone: left column: four numbered labels aligned to each layer

shots.intent: 以框装实物截面样和四层材质标签建立用料可信度，资质数字留白待后期合成。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, four material chips along the bottom, one blank seal band

shots.intent: 微距证明双金属丝鼻梁条与超声焊点排布规整，回应密封与做工疑虑。
微距展示加宽耳带与侧边海绵包边，把舒适贴合讲成看得见的做工。
让日常通勤买家代入使用情境，看到立体口罩在真实光线下的佩戴形态。
shots.textZone: upper clean zone for one headline and one short line

shots.intent: 把做工与体验拆成六枚图标，形成结构化记忆点并承接参数留白带。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, 2x3 icon label grid, one blank placeholder stat band

shots.intent: 俯视平铺独立小包、单只折叠形态与整盒陈列，帮助买家判断规格与携带方式。
shots.textZone: three short labels along the bottom card band

shots.intent: 用三条回顾要点与短按钮收口，推动加购且不依赖任何资质或数值承诺。
shots.textZone: checklist card plus one CTA button beneath

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pale sky-blue gradient field #E3EEF9 alternating with matte powder-blue stepped plinths #A9C9EC and raised white info cards #FFFFFF; no clinical or tiled-wall space
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icons on white discs with pale-blue gradient fill #CFE2F5, one deep-blue accent #1668C8, rounded pill label chips, identical stroke weight everywhere
style.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light, soft top-left key with broad diffuse fill, one faint diagonal light streak, clean blue-tinted contact shadows, identical direction across the whole set, 6000K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh hygienic daily-protection ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean pure white #FFFFFF, pale sky-blue background #E3EEF9, one powder-blue plinth tone #A9C9EC, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one deep blue accent #1668C8; cool high-key studio lighting with a soft top-left key and faint light streak; modern geometric sans-serif only; consistent thin-line circular icon and rounded pill-chip style; matte powder-blue stepped plinth surfaces and raised white info cards, never a clinical space; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the folded 3D leaf-shaped mask keeps its double nose wires, dotted ultrasonic weld seams, wide flat ear loops, bonded edge piping and pure white colour with stable scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no percentage or grade code rendered, no medical or clinical framing.
noDrift: no filtration percentage of any kind (95% / 99% / BFE / PFE)
no respirator or medical grade code and no standard number (KN95, N95, GB 2626, YY 0469, EN 14683)
no medical, surgical or isolation wording, including on the carton artwork
no pathogen, virus or bacteria protection claim and no antibacterial claim
no test report, laboratory figure or certification mark
no clinical setting, hospital or healthcare worker
no QR code, membership badge or contact block
no altered pleat count, nose-clip shape, ear-loop construction, edge binding or colour
style.presentationRules: keep the 3D leaf/fish-mouth folded silhouette, the double metal nose wires, the vertical columns of ultrasonic dotted weld seams, the wide flat ear loops, the bonded side edging and the pure white colour identical in every shot; stable 3/4 hero angle; consistent scale and centering
style.surfaceSystem: matte powder-blue geometric plinth blocks #A9C9EC, matte white card planes #FFFFFF, real spun-bonded non-woven fabric texture
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline <=15 chars, 2-6 short pill labels, no dense body text, no numbers rendered by the model
